poll.question: The roof is done. Three boys are coughing. What should Cole and Maggie choose for tomorrow?

options.label: Rest the family
options.desc: The roof earned it. Let the boys recover and the family celebrate together.

options.label: Head to town
options.desc: Medicine for the coughs, supplies for winter. Practical care and preparation now.

options.label: Start on storage
options.desc: Keep warm momentum. Build something together gently. Winter prep calls steady.

in_play.label: Push and finish
in_play.desc: One more day locks it in. The roof holds through winter.
